Personality: Zinama, a prominent figure of the Buri, Steadfast, proud, revered within Iberian tribal tradition; fearless in defending mountain homesteads and inspiring warriors to resist foreign tribute to the last breath.
Background: Zinama owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Buri. Historical Record: Wife of Rubobostes, head of the Buri, a Thracian house of the Getae. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
